description: Run one object-registry operation. Set `action` to list (the objects in use, shipped or your own, business objects first; OODS Foundry's internal objects are listed only when includeInternal is true, each entry carries its visibility and hiddenInternal counts the ones left out; and every definition file not in use with the reason), show (full object definition incl. composed traits and view extensions), validate (check an object or trait definition given as YAML, and compose it, without writing), register (write it into your folder, OODS_OBJECTS_DIR or OODS_TRAITS_DIR, from npm ~/.oods-foundry/objects and traits, once it validates and composes in every context it declares; overwrite: true replaces one of yours) or reload (read the folders again without a restart). Your object with a shipped object's name is used in its place and reported; your trait cannot reuse a shipped trait's name. A trait of yours places only components OODS Foundry ships. Consolidates the former object.* tools. Optional relationships declare target, via field, cardinality and label; validate/register return typed errors for unknown targets or fields, and show exposes the declarations.

inputSchema.description: Grouped action-parameter tool for the object registry (list, show, validate, register, reload). The top-level `action` selects which per-action contract applies; each branch reproduces the exact body of the per-action input schema (object.<action>.input.json) with the discriminator key `action` added to its allowed properties.

action.description: Selects the per-action contract: 'list' returns the objects in use with their source, business objects first and internal ones only with includeInternal, and every file not in use; 'show' returns the full composed definition for one object; 'validate' checks an object or trait definition without writing; 'register' writes one into your folder once it validates and composes; 'reload' re-reads the folders without a restart.

context.description: Optional: filter view_extensions to a single context (e.g. 'detail', 'list', 'form', 'timeline', 'card', 'inline'). Actions: show.

domain.description: Filter to objects in a specific domain (e.g. 'core.identity', 'saas.billing'). Actions: list.

includeInternal.description: Also list OODS Foundry's internal (non-business) objects, after the business objects. Without it they are left out and hiddenInternal counts them. Actions: list.

maturity.description: Filter by metadata maturity level. Actions: list.

name.description: Object name to look up (e.g. 'User', 'Product', 'Invoice'). Actions: show (required).

overwrite.description: Replace a definition of yours with this name; without it a name you already registered is refused (OODS-C004). Actions: register.

trait.description: Filter to objects composing a given trait (e.g. 'Priceable', 'lifecycle/Stateful'). Actions: list.

yaml.description: The whole definition as YAML: an object file starts with "object:", a trait file with "trait:" (the same format as OODS Foundry's own objects/ and traits/). Actions: validate (required), register (required).

name: object
